strings.ui_profile_delete_confirm: This cannot be undone. Delete this save?
strings.ui_profile_backup_loaded: The main save was damaged, so the backup was loaded.
strings.ui_quit_confirm: Return to the main menu? Your progress is saved first.

strings.ui_credits_body:
Roti Lezat Tycoon

Every model, icon, sound and song in this game is generated by code.
Built with Godot Engine (MIT license).

Thank you for playing!
strings.ui_character_note: Your choice changes only how your baker looks.
strings.ui_bakery_name_invalid: Please use 1 to 24 characters, without line breaks.
strings.ui_feedback_nothing_to_do: Nothing to do here right now
strings.ui_equipment_slots_full: All slots are in use. Replace one?
strings.ui_upgrade_max: You own the finest bakery in town!
strings.ui_upgrade_blocked_display: Not enough display space would remain for your bread.
strings.ui_staff_duty_cashier: Runs a checkout lane of their own and packs RotiFood orders when the lane is quiet.
strings.ui_staff_duty_baker: Runs the kitchen on their own: mixes, bakes and fills the shelves. Sits in the staff chair when every shelf is full.
strings.ui_decor_hint: Tap or drag a piece of furniture to pick it up.
strings.ui_decor_invalid_zone: It does not belong in this area
strings.ui_decor_invalid_path: That would block the path for customers or staff
strings.ui_decor_invalid_access: It needs a free tile in front
strings.ui_decor_invalid_reserved: This tile is a walkway and must stay clear
strings.ui_decor_invalid_blocks_access: Another station needs this tile to be used
strings.ui_decor_legend_clear: Red striped tiles must stay clear so customers and staff can walk through.
strings.ui_decor_legend_zone: Grey dotted tiles are outside the area where this item belongs.
strings.ui_decor_warn_walkway: It would block the walkway customers and staff use.
strings.ui_decor_warn_access: It would block the tile needed to use another station.
strings.ui_decor_valid: Looks good here. Tap Place to put it down.
strings.ui_decor_move_hint: Drag it, or tap any tile to move it there. Tap Place when it looks right.
strings.ui_decor_place_hint: Drag it where you want it, or tap a tile, then tap Place.
strings.ui_decor_slots_full: {type} spots are full ({count}/{count}). Put one away, or upgrade the shop for more.
strings.ui_decor_slot_hint_wall: Tap a glowing spot on the wall to try it there, then tap Place.
strings.ui_decor_slot_hint_counter: Tap a glowing spot on a counter to try it there, then tap Place.
strings.ui_decor_pick_slot: Tap one of the glowing spots.
strings.ui_decor_rug_hint: Drag the rug, or tap a shop tile to move it there. Rotate turns it; tap Place when it looks right.
strings.ui_decor_slot_usage_tip: Decorations in use at this shop. A bigger shop has more spots.
strings.ui_settings_mute_unfocused: Mute when the game is in the background
strings.ui_help_replay_note: Replaying a tip never resets your progress.
strings.ui_tutorial_skip_confirm: Skip the tutorial? Days 1 to 3 still follow the opening schedule.
strings.tut_welcome: Welcome to your bakery! First, let's arrange it your way. Then we'll bake your first loaf.
strings.tut_decor_open: First, make the bakery yours. Tap Decoration Mode.
strings.tut_decor_move: Drag any furniture to a new spot, like this shelf. Then tap Place.
strings.tut_decor_done: Nice! Tap Done to go back and start baking.
strings.tut_tap_storage: Tap Storage to choose a recipe.
strings.tut_baking: The oven is baking. Its ring fills up until the bread is ready.
strings.tut_take_tray: The bread is ready! Tap the Oven to take the tray out.
strings.tut_again_storage: Your first bread is on the shelf! Let's bake one more batch. Tap Storage.
strings.tut_choose_recipe_again: Choose a recipe and tap Make.
strings.tut_mixer_again: Tap the Mixer to mix the new batch.
strings.tut_to_table: This time, park the tray on the holding table in the kitchen. It keeps bread when the shelves are full.
strings.tut_skip_open: The tray waits on the table until a shelf has room. Now tap Skip to Open to open the shop right away!
strings.tut_tour_rating: This is your shop rating. Sales and quick service raise it; customers who leave unhappy lower it. More stars bring more customers.
strings.tut_tour_rotifood_rating: This is your RotiFood rating. Orders packed before the driver arrives raise it; late or rejected orders lower it. More stars bring more orders.
strings.tut_tour_rotifood_orders: RotiFood delivery orders show up here, and the RotiFood button rings. Tap an order and pack it before the driver arrives.
strings.tut_buyer_wait: The shop is open! Your first customer is on the way.
strings.tut_buyer_enter: Your first customer! Customers pick bread from your shelves, then line up at the counter to pay.
strings.tut_serve_wait: Stay at the counter. Customers lose patience while they wait, so serve them quickly!
strings.tut_serve_tap: Your customer is waiting. Tap them or the counter to see their order.
strings.tut_serve_pack: Stay at the counter while you pack their bread.
strings.tut_first_sale: Your first sale! Coins go into your cash as soon as the bread is paid for.
strings.tut_surprise: A little surprise! Visits like this happen now and then. They are just for fun and never change your sales.
strings.tut_rotifood_first: Your first RotiFood order! Tap it, then tap Pack Order. The driver picks it up at the counter.
strings.tut_staff_open: Tap Staff Management to meet the people who want to work for you.
strings.tut_speed: Speed up quiet hours with 2× and 3×, or pause the game here.
strings.tut_close_early: Close Early ends the day right away. Wages stay the same, and your shop rating drops a little for every hour you cut.
strings.tut_stale: Some bread on this shelf went stale. Fewer customers want it, and picky ones refuse it. Tap the shelf to see it and discard it.
strings.tut_badge: You earned a badge! Open Decoration Mode to hang it on a wall.
strings.tut_choose_recipe: Choose a recipe and a batch size.
strings.tut_tap_mixer: Tap the Mixer to start mixing.
strings.tut_equipment_works: The equipment keeps working while you move around.
strings.tut_mixer_done: Mixing is done. Tap the Mixer again to pick up the dough.
strings.tut_to_oven: Take the dough to the Oven.
strings.tut_burn_risk: Take it out before it burns.
strings.tut_choose_slot: Choose a Display slot for the finished bread.
strings.tut_patience: Customers lose patience while they wait.
strings.tut_window_shopper: Some visitors only look around. They leave without buying, and that is okay.
strings.tut_manual_cashier: Stand at the cashier to serve customers until you hire a Cashier Assistant.
strings.tut_income: Coins go into your cash as soon as the bread is paid for.
strings.tut_rotifood: RotiFood orders do not reserve stock until you pack them.
strings.tut_summary: This is your Daily Summary: income, costs, utilities, waste and ratings.
strings.tut_freshness: Bread ages on the display: Fresh, then Good, then Stale. Leftovers stay overnight until they expire.
strings.tut_day2_prep: A new day! Your ingredients are in Storage.
strings.tut_office_worker: Office workers are in a hurry. Serve them quickly!
strings.tut_queue_capacity: The queue has limited spots. When it is full, new customers wait outside.
strings.tut_day3_balance: Keep enough bread for both walk-in customers and RotiFood orders.
strings.tut_market_unlock: The Market is open from now on.
strings.tut_market_teaser: From tomorrow, you can order ingredients at any time. Daytime deliveries take 3 in-game hours.
strings.thought_quiet_1: Hmm... why hasn't anyone come in yet?
strings.thought_quiet_3: Is my shop really that unpopular? Maybe my bread isn't any good...
strings.thought_quiet_4: Maybe I should just take up catfish farming instead.
strings.window_shopper_line_2: Oh right, I have no money.
strings.window_shopper_line_3: I think I'll just get a burger instead.
strings.window_shopper_line_4: Wait, why did I even come in here?
strings.window_shopper_line_5: I thought this was a minimarket.
strings.window_shopper_line_6: Smells amazing... but I'm on a diet.
strings.window_shopper_line_8: My wallet says no. My tummy says yes.
strings.window_shopper_line_10: Do they sell phone credit here?
strings.staff_line_first_day: Whoa, my first day! I hope I don't let anyone down.
strings.staff_line_raise: I wonder when I'll get a raise...
strings.staff_line_own_bakery: Will I have my own bakery someday?
strings.staff_line_cat: I wonder what my cat is doing at home.
strings.staff_line_dinner: What should I get for dinner after work?
strings.staff_line_smell: The smell of fresh bread never gets old.
strings.staff_line_no_snacking: Note to self: do NOT eat the display bread.
strings.staff_line_mom: I should call my mom tonight. She'd love this place.
strings.staff_line_rain_or_shine: Rain or shine, warm bread makes everything better.
strings.staff_line_boss: The boss works so hard. I want to be just like that!
strings.staff_line_radio_song: That song from the radio is stuck in my head again.
strings.staff_line_weekend: Maybe I'll try baking at home this weekend.
strings.staff_line_crumbs: Crumbs on my apron again... oh well!
strings.staff_line_regulars: I hope our regulars stop by today.
strings.staff_line_knead_pun: I knead a vacation. Get it? Knead?
strings.staff_line_stretch: Stretch... and smile! Okay, ready again.
strings.staff_line_cashier_prices: I know every price by heart. Try me!
strings.staff_line_cashier_kaching: Ka-ching! Best sound in the world.
strings.staff_line_baker_rest: Knead, fold, rest... I could use a rest too.
strings.staff_line_baker_arms: All this kneading is giving me super strong arms!
strings.staff_line_baker_flour: Is there flour on my nose again?
strings.staff_line_baker_batch: Something smells like a perfect batch!
strings.staff_line_good_day: Something tells me today is going to be a good day.
strings.staff_line_bike_home: I hope it doesn't rain on my bike ride home.
strings.staff_line_compliment: A customer said my smile was nice yesterday. Hehe!
strings.staff_line_new_recipe: I wonder what new recipe the boss will try next.
strings.staff_line_tummy: My tummy just growled. Did anyone hear that?
strings.staff_line_plants: I should water my plants when I get home.
strings.staff_line_diary: Dear diary, the bread smelled amazing today. Again.
strings.staff_line_karaoke: Karaoke after work? Maybe just one song...
strings.staff_line_lottery: If I win the lottery, I'd still come to work. Probably.
strings.staff_line_comfy_shoes: New shoes, comfy feet, happy me!
strings.staff_line_friends: My friends think working at a bakery is so cool.
strings.staff_line_butter: Deep breath... smells like butter and happiness.
strings.staff_line_cashier_smile: Smile check! Ready for the next customer.
strings.staff_line_cashier_bags: I folded these paper bags perfectly. Look at them!
strings.staff_line_cashier_umbrella: I hope the lady with the polka-dot umbrella comes by today.
strings.staff_line_cashier_drawer: Shiny coins, tidy drawer, happy cashier.
strings.staff_line_baker_oven_friend: The oven is my best friend. Don't tell the mixer.
strings.staff_line_baker_pillow: This dough is softer than my pillow.
strings.staff_line_baker_secret: My secret ingredient? A pinch of love.
strings.staff_cashier_budi_line: Okay Budi, count the change slowly. You can do it!
strings.staff_cashier_sari_line: Good morning, everyone~! Hehe, just practicing my greeting.
strings.staff_cashier_dimas_line: Lovely weather today, isn't it? ...Oh, nobody's here.
strings.staff_cashier_tejo_line: Back in the 90s, I counted change with my eyes closed!
strings.staff_cashier_luna_line: Should I sing a little song for the next customer?
strings.staff_baker_joko_line: Mmm... I was daydreaming about bread again.
strings.staff_baker_ani_line: Just one tiny taste of jam... for quality control!
strings.staff_baker_fajar_line: Perfectly even croissant layers... that's the dream.
strings.staff_baker_aoi_line: Every crepe must be perfect. Every single one.
strings.staff_baker_mawar_line: This kitchen reminds me of my grandmother's. So cozy.
strings.surprise_kid_whee: Wheee! Catch me if you can!
strings.mood_great: What a day! Your bread sold like hotcakes!
strings.hl_low_ingredients: Ingredients are running low! Don't forget the Market.
strings.tip_default: Every loaf you bake is a step forward. See you tomorrow!
strings.ui_overflow_body: Your fortune is now too large to count. The bakery keeps going, just for fun.
strings.ui_record_most_bread_sold_day: Most Bread Sold in One Day
strings.ui_record_most_customers_day: Most Customers Served in One Day
strings.ui_record_most_rotifood_day: Most RotiFood Orders Completed in One Day
strings.ach_no_burn_day_desc: Finish a day without a burnt batch.
strings.ach_week_no_burn_desc: Go 7 days in a row without a burnt batch.
strings.ach_queue_master_desc: Finish a day without any customer losing patience.
strings.ach_tier5_desc: Upgrade to the Mega Bakery Landmark.
strings.ach_all_recipes_desc: Produce every recipe at least once.
strings.ach_price_experiment_desc: Sell bread below 80% and above 125% of its reference price.
strings.ach_rain_delivery_desc: Complete 20 RotiFood orders on one rainy day.
strings.ach_solo_recovery_desc: Recover from a bailout and reach more than 5,000 KR.
strings.ach_big_day_desc: Earn more than 50,000 KR in one day.
strings.staff_cashier_budi: A diligent first-year student. He gets flustered counting change, but his smile is always genuine.
strings.staff_cashier_sari: The friendly girl next door who greets every customer like a Sunday-morning cartoon host.
strings.staff_cashier_dimas: Loves chatting about the weather so much that he sometimes forgets to press Confirm.
strings.staff_cashier_tejo: A legendary 90s department-store cashier who can count change with his eyes closed.
strings.staff_cashier_luna: A local idol on a relaxed side job; the counter is always buzzing when she's around.
strings.staff_baker_joko: Can knead heavy dough for hours, but tends to daydream when the oven dings.
strings.staff_baker_ani: Always tastes the jam before spreading it, and loves learning new baking tricks.
strings.staff_baker_fajar: Rolls croissant dough to a perfectly even thickness.
strings.staff_baker_aoi: A perfectionist from Kyoto who stacks flawless matcha mille crepes.
strings.staff_baker_mawar: A grandmother with a secret family recipe book and a story for every loaf.
strings.ui_stat_total_customers_missed: Customers who could not get in
strings.onb_welcome: Your bakery runs itself. Watch your first bread sell!
strings.onb_first_sale: Your first sale! This is your KR, and this is how much you earn every second.
strings.onb_first_upgrade: You can afford an oven upgrade. Tap its level chip to make it faster!
strings.onb_tap_boost: Tap a working station to speed it up!
strings.onb_hire: You can hire help now. Open Staff and hire a Kitchen Assistant.
strings.onb_recipe: A new recipe is in reach. Open Menu, unlock it and put it on a shelf slot.
strings.onb_offline: Welcome back! Your bakery kept earning while you were away.
strings.onb_location: A bigger shop is in reach. Open Shop to move there.
strings.onb_franchise: You can franchise now: sell this bakery for Franchise Stars that boost every new branch.
strings.ui_turn_upright: Turn your phone upright for a bigger view.
strings.ui_slot_auto_desc: Always sells your most profitable recipe (now {recipe})
strings.ui_menu_needs_tier: Needs a Tier {tier} mixer and oven
strings.ui_effect_offline_hours: Earns while away for up to {value} h
strings.ui_milestone_shelf_model: new shelf model with more slots
strings.ui_shop_move_confirm: Move the bakery to {to} for {price}? Customers leave politely, and every level, recipe and staff member comes along.
strings.ui_shop_open_no_room: No free spot. Move furniture in Decor to make room.
strings.ui_welcome_back_body: You were away for {time}. Your bakery earned {amount}.
strings.ui_welcome_back_lurah: Pak Lurah: "I kept an eye on the shop for you. The ovens never stopped!"
strings.ui_welcome_back_capped: Only the first {hours} h away count. Longer Away Shifts in the Shop raises the limit.
strings.ui_offline_cap: Earns while you are away for up to {hours} h at {percent}%
strings.ui_franchise_bonus: Every star adds {percent}% to all income
strings.ui_franchise_need_tier: Move up to the {location} to open a franchise.
strings.ui_franchise_need_stars: Keep baking: selling now would not earn a new star yet.
strings.ui_franchise_confirm: Sell this bakery and open a new branch? Your stars, perks and badges stay.
strings.ui_franchise_resets: Starts over: KR, location, stations, recipes, staff, reputation and shop upgrades up to Lv 5.
strings.ui_franchise_keeps: You keep: stars, perks, badges, decorations, stats and shop upgrades above Lv 5.
strings.ui_franchise_cut_1: Pak Lurah: "Big news! An investor loved your bakery so much that they bought it!"
strings.ui_franchise_cut_2: Pak Lurah: "Here is a fresh little shop for your next branch. Same name, bigger dreams!"
strings.perk_offline_plus_desc: Earns while you are away for {offline_hours} h longer
strings.perk_free_baker_desc: Your first Kitchen Assistant joins every new branch for free
strings.perk_offline_efficiency_desc: Earns {offline_efficiency} more of your KR/s while away
strings.perk_recipe_memory_desc: New branches keep every recipe you ever unlocked
strings.perk_milestone_triple_desc: Recipe milestones multiply the price by {recipe_milestone_mult} instead of 2
